known.evidence: F1A-009: no role/aria-live on toast or container; classes shadow-sm backdrop-blur + raw red/amber palette (computed blur(8px)); dark error bg #460809 dE 25.7 vs --status-danger-soft, warning #461901 dE 23.9; light red-50/amber-50; x button aria-label 'Dismiss' but 7x15 px; auto-dismiss ~3.05 s for errors; covers Assistant / Toggle side panel / ERC and BOM 'Show in schematic'/'PCB'.

F1A-005: DesignerDrcView.tsx:114/121 silent catches confirmed. GET /drc 500 → 'Run DRC to validate the board.' + status '0 DRC' (report has 33); projection 500 → permanent '?.1 ↔ ?.2', 'net pt:…', Edit rules disabled, no error. (model-conversion.ts part was confirmed by Q6-024.)

PCB analog: projection/pcb 500 does not spin forever; shows 'PCB projection unavailable' with no reason/retry and recovers only on view switch (F1A-012). Schematic K09 itself already confirmed by Q3-025.
Designer command/DRC/ERC/export/DXF failures surface raw problem titles ('Internal error'), 'Failed to fetch' and parser text; see F1A-006, F1A-010, F1A-011.
No white screen across all failure/latency injections in designer; but 2 uncaught promise rejections (comment createThread, rules save) confirm there is no global unhandledrejection handler.
